rationale: Y independently surfaces the exact tension the human reviewer raised about _AdmissionWaitDecision (private-vs-extension-point, missing invariant enforcement) via points #5 and #7, and correctly diagnoses the same vacuous-test issue X found but ties it precisely to the new max_num_running_reqs<=1 condition with verified reasoning. X mostly confirms already-fixed items (finiteness checks, TTS parity) rather than surfacing new/outstanding concerns, and one of its two 'test proves nothing' claims (zero_max_wait test) mischaracterizes a test that is actually testing its stated condition correctly. Y's findings are more numerous, more rigorously verified (explicit trace-throughs, run confirmations), and more directly actionable with precise fixes.
